title: Level is the only lever on who fights
body: Deployment is by combat power, not ATK, and power follows level: raise the 40 you want. Unwanted cookies go to Lv.1 (ND러너) or just under 40th (EOG, VART).

title: Exact levels since 9/23
body: Since 2026-09-23 a long press on level-up opens fine control; that's how players type in exact levels.

title: The Rift buff skews the shown power order
body: Displayed power includes the Dimensional Rift buff, so the 40 can deploy out of the order the lineup screen shows. Test with a run.

title: Pomegranate's beam picks by synergy, then by ATK
body: The beam (석류빔, 빨대) hits Projectile Speed synergy holders first, so Milk always, then by live ATK. Other holders would steal it: level them out.

title: Who takes the beam after Milk
body: The 578G run beams Brightseeker, then Figure and Scorpion; other top lineups put Scorpion second. ND러너 beamed the buffers, Macaron and Figure.

title: Synergy-first is unconfirmed
body: EOG calls the synergy-first reading unconfirmed; an English guide restating ND러너's method calls it observed behaviour to verify.

title: Milk is the engine: captain, top ATK, centre of the formation
body: Captain at top ATK in every documented top run. One tester found Passion Pay ranks ATK without the captain's +10%; repliers agreed, ND러너 reportedly disagrees.

title: Milk must reach the centre early
body: Its stacking ATK buff has a range: keep the formation packed. Milk arriving at once (about 53 s on the countdown) scores high; trailing in scores low.

title: Stacked buffs since 9/10
body: Before 2026-09-10 a same-type buff replaced a stacked one: Cheesecake erased Milk's stacks, Lime erased Macaron's. Lineups left both out.

title: Cheesecake back in since 9/10
body: The stronger stacked value now wins. By 9/21 players rated Cheesecake's buff on Milk a top-two factor; the 325.9G run keeps it sixth in ATK.

title: Lower Pomegranate to bring Milk out
body: Pomegranate near Lv.60 and fewer supports in the 40 get Milk to the front at once (reports of 10-07). Keep Pomegranate inside the 40.

title: Chargers and summoners break the formation
body: Chargers run around the boss and Milk follows to heal the lowest-HP ally, so the ranged dealers lose every buff. Summoners spread the formation too.

title: Level them out, with exceptions
body: Out of the 40: the Exclusions page (Princess Bari since 9/23). Kept: Figure and Vampire, which stay at the boss; Red Pepper and Dark Cherry, which draw Milk forward.

title: The Holy Golden Drop's patterns
body: Per the wiki: a floor squash that knocks cookies back, lightning strikes, and summoned Golden Soldier Drops.

title: Boss timings players report
body: A slam at about 20 s left kills weak buffers; a jump scatters cookies; a late sweep wipes the team (15 s left at lower power, 8 s at higher).

title: EOG's model: the first 13 s decide a run
body: A model, not data: the shockwave throws the team back four times, adds score nothing, and the boss raises its damage reduction three times (stacking to five).

title: Conquest-only effects don't apply
body: Tea Knight's boss-damage buff works only in Guild Conquest, so it gives nothing here; focus still matters for Devil's and Dark Choco's DEF shred.

title: Mercenary perks
body: Lv.4: Passion Pay (on Milk) plus Rapid Promotion (most) or Like A Family. Lv.3: Rapid Promotion alone; lower: all-stats. One poster ran ATK 20% with '5사격'.

title: Like A Family
body: Elemental damage per cookie of the most-fielded element. Best for ND러너 and 누리머; 전치 found Rapid Promotion a little higher by score ÷ power, 30+ runs each, too few runs to be sure.

title: No pet selection
body: No pet slots. EOG reads pets' passives and Collection bonuses as applying to every cookie anyway; pets' ATK bonuses shift the ATK order.

title: KR and global share the servers
body: Rankings are per server. One client (1.4.002), one server list: KR boards show English- and Chinese-named rivals, and global EOG reports from 'Server 1'.

title: Board size
body: Weekly participation runs from a few dozen to about 320 players per server.
